title: Finite-to-Continuum Osterwalder-Schrader Reconstruction and Symanzik Improvement in Lattice Gauge Theory
description:
Proves in Lean 4 the continuum reconstruction theorems for 4D lattice gauge theory: symanzik_rotational_defect_vanishes_unconditional (rotational defect vanishes quadratically as O(a^2)) and os_continuum_mass_gap_and_clustering_from_uniform_dobrushin (Osterwalder-Schrader spectral mass gap Delta >= m_0 > 0 from uniform spatial clustering). Verified with zero sorry.

Methodology: In accordance with open research principles, ai is being used as a tool for formal verification synthesis and computational checks.

Epistemic Status: Finite structural theorem; Clay Millennium open horizons remain strictly open.
